body: As I gaze out at the wet planks, my mind starts racing with the possibilities of the storm, the wind, and the flooding. I think about our community's safety and resilience, and I feel a surge of determination to help in any way I can. I put a comforting hand on their arm and tell them, "Stay by me and let's face this together."
